messages:
zoe: hi team, first week here! opened my first PR touching the serving-config and a tiny helper. CI failed on `lint` and `unit-coverage`. quick q: preferred branch format and anything obvious I missed in the PR template? :smile:

marc: welcome Zoe! branch format: `feature/onb-<ticket>-short-desc` lowercase. PR template lists checklist: tests, changelog line, and `pre-commit` (we run it in CI). Paste the lint failure if you're stuck.

zoe: lint errors are from trailing commas and a typescript rule I didn't know about. I ran `pre-commit` locally but it didn't catch the ts rule.

emily: are you on the project's node version? We pin with `.nvmrc` and the eslint plugin is installed by `yarn install`. Run `yarn` then `yarn lint --fix`. If rule persists, check `package.json` overrides.

zoe: ah I had an older node; `nvm use` fixed it. re-ran lint and fixed most. unit-coverage still failing with a new failing assertion in `tests/unit/config_test.py`. Locally it passes though.

marc: flaky tests are usually due to order or test env. Try `pytest -k config_test -q` and `pytest tests/unit -k test_that_fails -vv`. Also CI runs with `PYTEST_ADDOPTS='--maxfail=1'`. If it passes locally but fails in CI, add a small sleep or seed randomness and file an issue for flakiness.

zoe: ran the specific test and saw a race on temp dir cleanup. Pushing a fix. One procedural q: do we squash on merge or keep commits?

emily: we squash merge by default and use a conventional commit-ish title in the single commit message. Keep your branch history tidy while WIP, but it's fine to have several pushes. Also add a line in `changelogs/unreleased.md` with the GH PR link and 1-line summary.

marc: reviewers: CODEOWNERS will auto-request. For config/runtime touches ping @marc and @infra-team. We try to get one human approval + passing CI checks. If it's your first PR add the `first-time-contributor` label.

devex-bot: Tip: If your PR touches multiple subsystems consider splitting it. Small PRs get reviewed faster. Use `draft` status for WIP. See /docs/dev/pr-guidelines for the checklist.

zoe: thanks! renamed branch to `feature/onb-789-config-cleanup`, added changelog entry, and pushed the test fix. tagging @marc for review. Appreciate the quick help :rocket:

emily: taking a look now. small nit: move the helper from `src/serving/helpers.py` to `src/serving/_internal.py` and add a unit test to exercise edge case. Otherwise looks good.

zoe: will update and push a follow-up. glad to be onboarded! :wave:
